name: Madelyn Eschart
japaneseName: マデリン・エッシャルト
description: Madelyn Eschart is the Sixth (formerly Ninth) ranking Divine General of the Sacred Vollachia Empire, known as the 'Flying Dragon General'. A Dragonkin born from the Dragon Mezoreia who commands flying dragon packs, she played an antagonistic role throughout Arc 7 and Arc 8 before assisting in the defense of the Empire.
